subject: Whether the egress width requirement shown in Project Specifications Division 00 complies

messages.text: We need confirmation on whether the egress width requirement shown in Project Specifications Division 00 complies with the adopted code edition referenced in Section 23 05 00, though this may simply come down to what the design intended rather than a strict code reading. This is becoming a priority as the affected work proceeds. No cost impact is anticipated. This could affect the certificate of occupancy schedule. There is no specific deadline for this, but a timely response is appreciated.
